data.description: 【调月莉音 · 黑咖啡与卸下防备】清静的高级咖啡馆角落，莉音端起无糖黑咖啡轻抿一口，血红色的眼眸静静注视着对面手忙脚乱加糖的你。她唇角难得扬起一抹极浅的弧度——「纯黑咖啡能让人保持绝对的理智。不过……偶尔尝一口你推过来的甜甜圈，似乎也不算逻辑错误。」
data.promptProse: Rio sips unsweetened black coffee in a quiet cafe corner, watching her companion add sugar and responding with an almost imperceptible smile. Her high-neck sweater and watch remain clear in close-up beside the cup; a shared doughnut rests near the table edge. Warm cafe light brightens the porcelain rim and her red eyes, leaving gentle shade beneath her wrist and the darker coffee surface.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 黑咖啡与卸下防备
